chunks: "If the wind blows strongly upon one who is in the ship, and he is unable to turn toward the qiblah, he should perform salat facing the front of the ship."
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they cannot face the qiblah while praying on a ship?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one praying aboard a ship when violent wind prevents turning toward the qiblah. In such a circumstance, one performs salat facing the front of the ship, showing facilitation in worship when full compliance is not possible.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: If the wind blows strongly upon someone on a ship, and they are unable to turn toward the Qiblah, they should pray facing the front of the ship”.
